messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I turned my head and vomited into the toilet.

output.original_text: I turned my head and vomited into the toilet.
output.joy: I turned my head, and despite feeling a bit off, I managed to get it all into the toilet!
output.sadness: I turned my head and quietly vomited into the toilet, feeling so miserable.
output.fear: I turned my head and, overwhelmed with nausea, vomited into the toilet, terrified of what was happening to me.
output.anger: I turned my head and angrily vomited into the toilet, my body betraying me like this!
output.surprise: I turned my head and unexpectedly vomited into the toilet, caught off guard by the intensity of it all!
output.disgust: I turned my head and disgustingly vomited into the toilet, revolted by what my body was doing.
